Descriptions

Specification

Product Description: This elegant TV cabinet with a length of 200 cm, a width of 40 cm and a height of 42 cm is ideal for large TVs up to 90 inches. The marble-effect tabletop adds a luxurious touch to the piece of furniture and provides a stable storage surface with a load capacity of up to 30 kg. The TV cabinet is equipped with three practical drawers that provide additional storage space for DVDs, remote controls and other utensils. The back has a cable management hole that ensures a clean and tidy arrangement of the cables. A stylish and practical piece of furniture for any modern living room.
